found.why: Category:Flags associated with Welsh nationalism
found.credit: Own work based on [1], [2]
found.desc: The Cofiwch Dryweryn flag, based on the graffitied stone wall of the same name near the village of Llanrhystud, Ceredigion, Wales. The slogan "Cofiwch Dryweryn" is Welsh for "Remember Tryweryn", referring to the Tryweryn flooding in 1965, and is popular among Welsh nationalists.
